jobs.occupation: Senior Network Specialist | Security & Hybrid Cloud
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced network professional who thrives in complex enterprise environments where security, reliability, and modern connectivity are business critical? Do you enjoy combining hands-on engineering with network modernization, cloud connectivity, and infrastructure improvement initiatives? If so, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.
 
Experis is currently looking for a Senior Network Specialist to join a long-term consulting assignment in Gothenburg. In this role, you will play a key part in strengthening and modernizing enterprise network services that support business operations across multiple locations. 

About the Role

As a Senior Network Specialist, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, operation, security, and continuous improvement of enterprise network services. You will work across both daily operational activities and strategic infrastructure initiatives, ensuring that the network environment remains secure, scalable, and highly available. The role involves close collaboration with internal stakeholders, Security teams, service providers, telecommunications partners, and infrastructure vendors. You will contribute to critical network projects while supporting business-critical connectivity and reducing operational risk. 

Key Responsibilities

Design, implement, maintain, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure
Manage LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, WLAN, internet connectivity, and remote access services
Configure and support routing, switching, segmentation, and connectivity solutions
Administer and maintain enterprise firewall platforms and network security controls
Design and support Site-to-Site VPN, Remote Access VPN, IPSec, and SSL VPN solutions
Monitor network performance, capacity, utilization, and availability
Troubleshoot network incidents and conduct root cause analysis
Support vulnerability remediation, patching, and network hardening initiatives
Collaborate with Security teams to ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards
Support connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and cloud platforms
Participate in infrastructure lifecycle management, upgrades, and modernization projects
Develop and maintain network documentation, standards, and topology diagrams
Coordinate with telecommunications providers, managed service partners, and vendors
Support migration projects, office expansions, and infrastructure transformations
Contribute to automation and operational efficiency improvements
Participate in on-call activities and support critical operational incidents when required

We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, Telecommunications, or equivalent experience
At least 3-5 years of experience within Network Engineering, Network Operations, Infrastructure Engineering, or a similar role
Proven experience managing enterprise network environments
Strong experience with Cisco, Fortinet, Huawei, or similar networking technologies
Extensive knowledge of routing and switching technologies
Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking and related protocols
Experience with LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, WLAN, internet edge, and remote access networks
Hands-on experience with firewall administration and network security solutions
Experience with VPN technologies including IPSec, SSL VPN, Site-to-Site VPN, and Remote Access VPN
Knowledge of network segmentation, access control, and Zero Trust principles
Experience supporting hybrid connectivity between on-premises and cloud-based environments
Professional proficiency in English

Technical Competencies

TCP/IP
BGP
OSPF
VLAN
STP
DNS
DHCP
NAT
Cisco Technologies
Fortinet Security Solutions
Network Security
VPN Technologies
SD-WAN
Hybrid Cloud Connectivity
High Availability Architectures
Enterprise Networking

Meritorious Experience

CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, or equivalent certifications
Network automation using Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar tools
Monitoring, observability, and network performance management platforms
ITIL-based service management processes
Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity planning
Experience from automotive, R&D, manufacturing, or other complex enterprise environments
Experience communicating technical risks and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders
Mandarin Chinese language skills

To Succeed in This Role, We Believe You Are

Analytical and solution-oriented
Proactive and self-driven
Structured and quality-focused
Comfortable taking ownership and driving initiatives independently
A strong collaborator with excellent communication skills
Passionate about secure, scalable, and modern network environments
Motivated by continuous improvement and operational excellence

We are looking for a Quality Engineer to join our team. You will become part of a supportive and knowledgeable department where experienced colleagues will help you develop your skills and build your career within quality engineering.
We are in an exciting phase of growth, with new projects, increasing customer demand, and ongoing investments in our operations. This creates excellent opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and gain hands-on experience in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
In this role, you will get valuable insight into how quality contributes to business success and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in, and drive, a variety of quality activities, from problem-solving and root cause analysis to process improvements and customer-related quality matters.
Whether you are early in your career or looking to take the next step, this position offers a great opportunity to develop your technical and professional skills while working with quality products and manufacturing processes in a collaborative environment.
Your primary area of responsibility will be our composite insulator manufacturing operations, where you will support daily quality activities and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives as part of our ongoing quality development journey.
 
How you’ll make an impact 
·       Support and gradually take ownership of quality activities related to products, processes, and customer requirements.
·       Coordinate investigations of quality deviations and customer complaints, driving resolution together with cross-functional teams.
·       Serve as quality contact and support customer communication on quality-related topics.
·       Lead or support structured problem-solving activities using methodologies such as 8D.
·       Analyze quality performance data and contribute to improvement initiatives.
·       Maintain and develop risk assessments, control plans, and quality documentation.
·       Participate in audits and support corrective action follow-up.
·       Collaborate with production teams to improve process capability, product quality, and operational performance.
 
Your background
·       A technical degree or equivalent experience from a manufacturing environment.
·       A hands-on mindset with the ability to get things done.
·       Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem-solving.
·       The ability to work methodically while maintaining a practical focus.
·       Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and create engagement among colleagues.
·       A collaborative approach and the ability to influence and drive quality improvements across the organization.
·       Good communication skills in Swedish and English, both written and verbal.
 
More About Us​
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​
​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
Health care and wellness allowance ​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
Psychological support program ​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

​
The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​

About the Role
We are looking for a Product Manager for Delivery Execution to join our Group Operations team. In this role, you will own one of our most business-critical product areas, sitting at the very core of our last-mile operations across Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Norway, and the Netherlands.
Working in close triad with an Engineering Manager and a Staff Engineer, you will set the direction, priorities, and roadmap for delivery execution. Together with the Product Manager Routing, you will share ownership of group routing KPIs covering efficiency and quality in Last Mile.
This role combines sharp user focus with analytical, business-driven problem-solving. You’ll work close to physical operations, dive deep into data, build business cases, and turn complex real-world challenges into scalable tech and operational solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Roadmap: Own the vision, roadmap, and prioritization for Delivery Execution.

Driver Tools: Serve as the company owner for our driver applications and associated delivery tooling.

Performance & Compensation: Develop and own our driver and courier performance frameworks, and guide courier compensation models.

Driver Lifecycle: Inform driver onboarding and career development pathways.

Operational Excellence: Drive continuous gains in cost efficiency, last-mile quality, and scalability across international markets.

Data & KPIs: Define, monitor, and iterate on routing KPIs, dashboards, and operational performance insights.

Consumer Experience: Set the standard for driver interactions with end consumers.

Bridging Tech & Ops: Act as the primary interface between central tech and local market operations to drive adoption and tangible business value.

Hardware Requirements: Identify and flag hardware requirements for last-mile drivers.

Your Future Team
You’ll join Group Operations, a central team collaborating closely with market operations, routing specialists, and engineering. The last-mile domain consists of two Product Managers sharing scope alongside dedicated data analysts, product designers, and engineers focused on turning high-level business strategy into execution.
What We’re Looking For
4+ years of experience in product management, business development, operations, or related analytical roles.

Relevant academic degree.

Proven track record of deconstructing complex operational or optimization problems into actionable product initiatives.

Strong business acumen with experience building business cases and prioritizing by financial and operational impact.

Strong capability working with data, KPIs, and performance dashboards.

Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse functions and organizational levels.

Fluency in English (Swedish is optional).

More About You
Action-Oriented in Ambiguity: You don’t wait for perfect data; you formulate hypotheses, build tests, and iterate quickly.

Grounded in Reality: You enjoy getting out into the field—visiting hubs and terminals, riding along with drivers, and validating insights in the real world rather than solely behind dashboards.

Pragmatic & Impact-Driven: While versed in modern product frameworks, you are equally comfortable championing direct operational adjustments when that delivers the highest business value.

What We Offer
High-visibility ownership of a business-critical product area with direct impact on bottom-line efficiency.

A collaborative, ambitious, and supportive product and engineering culture.

Rapid iteration cycles and the opportunity to see your work deployed at international scale.

Perks & Benefits:

🏢 Brand-New Office: Collaborative space in our new Stockholm HQ.

🐶 Dog-Friendly Office: Bring your dog to designated dog-friendly office spaces.

🏓 Fun & Games: Foosball, shuffleboard, ping pong, and a private karaoke room.

👶 Parental Top-Up: 6 months of parental pay support.

🎂 Birthday Off: An extra paid day off every year to celebrate your birthday.

⏰ Flexible Hybrid Setup: Modern working hours designed to fit your life.

About Instabee
Formed in 2022 by combining Budbee and Instabox (and operating brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy), Instabee delivers convenient e-commerce logistics to millions of consumers across Europe. We are fast-paced, customer-obsessed, and expanding rapidly across the Nordics and continental Europe.
Note: As part of our standard recruitment process in Sweden, mandatory background checks are conducted via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys.

Company description:
Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.
Job description: 
 Do you enjoy improving processes, working with data, and making systems easier for others to use? As our Sales Process Specialist for Northern Europe, you will bring together SAP expertise, master data, sales processes, and order flows to strengthen our Customer Center operations across the region.
  
 Join our teamYou will join Customer Center in Northern Europe in a broad specialist role, working closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, and other stakeholders. You will be a key point of contact for sales processes and SAP, helping colleagues solve issues and continuously improve how we work.
  
 Your missionYour mission is to develop and improve sales and customer service processes, with SAP S/4HANA at the center. You will combine hands-on process and data work with analysis, coordination, and user support.
  
 Your responsibilities include:
  Drive improvements in sales and Customer Center processes in SAP.
 Maintain and improve master data, pricing, and process quality.
 Support and train colleagues in SAP and sales-related processes.
 Monitor order flows and support issue resolution across the order-to-cash process.
 Analyze data and processes to identify improvement opportunities.
 Support new processes, system enhancements, and digital initiatives.
  
 
 Your profileWe believe you will thrive if you enjoy systems, structure, and problem-solving while also collaborating with people across the organization. You are analytical and detail-oriented, but pragmatic and able to see the broader business perspective. 
  
 We particularly value:
  Experience working with sales and order management processes in SAP S/4HANA, including customer master data, special order flows, consignment stock processes, and customer-specific sales setups.
 Strong Excel and analytical skills, with the ability to work with and compare data from different sources.
 Experience in areas such as master data, sales operations, Customer Care, Supply Chain, logistics, or business process improvement.
  
 
 Experience as an SAP Business Key User, master data specialist, logistics professional, or in another related position could provide a strong foundation.
  
 As the role supports Northern Europe, you need strong English communication skills. Another Nordic language is an advantage.
  
 We know that great candidates do not always meet every single requirement. If this role interests you and you believe your experience can contribute to our success, we encourage you to apply.
  
 Location and otherThe primary location is Örebro, Sweden, with the possibility of being based at other Epiroc sites within Northern Europe.
  
 A hybrid workplace is possible, and occasional travel within the region may be required. 
  
 Why Epiroc?By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact. 
  
 We offer global career opportunities, Learning & Development programs, a competitive benefits package, flexible ways of working, and opportunities for community involvement.  
  
 Application and contact informationWe encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than November 18th, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. 
  
 We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.
  
 For questions about the position, please contact:Hiring Manager, Josefin Rönnqvist, josefin.ronnqvist@epiroc.com Recruitment specialist, Otto Wetterström, otto.wetterstrom@external.epiroc.com

Ready for an active job in Stockholm? Join MoveByBike!
Looking for a job where you can stay active, work independently and spend your days moving around Stockholm rather than sitting behind a desk?
MoveByBike is expanding our delivery operations and is looking for new team members to work as Cargo Bike Drivers, E-Bike Drivers and Bike Couriers.
We use modern electric cargo bikes (el-lastcyklar) to transport parcels, groceries, batteries and other goods throughout Stockholm. As part of our delivery team, you will help keep the city moving while contributing to a more sustainable transport system.
We are particularly interested in candidates who want to work full-time or take on several shifts each week. Part-time opportunities are also available.
What does a typical working day look like?
Your job is to collect, transport and deliver goods using one of our electric cargo bikes.
You will:

Ride an electric cargo bike through Stockholm.

Deliver parcels, food products and other goods to customers.

Follow planned delivery routes and use digital navigation tools.

Handle deliveries carefully and professionally.

Work with our dispatch team to complete your daily assignments.

Follow traffic regulations and safety procedures.

This is an active, physically demanding job that involves working outdoors in different weather conditions, including during the Swedish winter.
If you enjoy cycling, physical activity and taking responsibility for your work, this could be a great fit.
Who are we looking for?
You don't need previous experience as a delivery driver or bike courier. What matters most is your attitude, reliability and willingness to learn.
To join our team, you must:

Be at least 18 years old.

Speak and understand Swedish or English.

Be comfortable cycling in urban traffic.

Be physically capable of handling an active delivery job.

Be reliable, punctual and able to follow work schedules.

Be prepared to work outdoors throughout the year.

No driver's license is required.
Previous experience in food delivery, parcel distribution, courier services or similar logistics work is an advantage, but not a requirement.
Flexible shifts – full-time and part-time
We offer both full-time and part-time employment opportunities.
Our delivery operations run between 08:00 and 22:00, including evenings and weekends.
We are especially interested in people who can work regularly and take on multiple shifts each week.

Full-time availability is highly valued.

Part-time employees must be available for at least 2 shifts per week (approximately 10 hours).

Evening and weekend shifts are available.

Students and people looking for additional work are welcome to apply.

Let us know your availability when submitting your application.
Pay, employment and equipment
Experienced riders earn approximately 155 SEK per hour on average, including base salary, performance bonuses and evening/weekend supplements. Holiday pay is added on top.
Actual earnings depend on the applicable supplements and performance bonuses.
All our riders receive an employment contract.
You will also receive the equipment needed to perform your work:

Electric cargo bike / e-bike.

Work phone for communication and navigation.

Professional work clothing.

How to join MoveByBike
We aim to make our recruitment process straightforward and efficient.

Submit your application online and upload your CV.

Meet our recruitment team for an interview if your application meets our requirements.

Show your cycling skills during a practical riding test with our operations team.

Get started with your employment contract, introduction and onboarding training if selected.

We are actively recruiting for our Stockholm operations and encourage candidates who are available to start soon to apply.
Why choose MoveByBike?
At MoveByBike, you become part of a team working to transform how goods are delivered in cities.
You'll enjoy an active working environment, supportive colleagues, opportunities for regular work and the chance to contribute to cleaner urban logistics.
Whether you are an experienced bicycle courier or looking for your first delivery job, we would like to hear from you.
Apply now – become an E-Bike Driver or Cargo Bike Courier with MoveByBike in Stockholm!
MoveByBike Recruitment Team

We are looking for an Accountant to join our Finance team at Senior Material Europe in Sweden. In this role, you will work with daily accounting operations, financial reporting, budgeting and audit support, contributing to the accuracy and efficiency of our financial processes.
This is a fixed-term position for 6 months (working on-site 4 days per week, approximately 30 hours per week) offering hands-on experience across a broad range of finance activities in an international industrial organisation.
About Senior Material Europe
At Senior Material Europe, we manufacture separator film – a thin film used in lithium-ion batteries, including batteries for electric vehicles. The separator is a key component that helps make lithium-ion batteries safer, more durable and more efficient, supporting the transition towards a more electrified future.
Our production is modern, advanced and operated under controlled cleanroom conditions. Together, we are building advanced manufacturing capabilities in Europe and developing solutions that make a difference – both today and for the future.
The Role
As an Accountant, you will support the daily operations of our Finance department and contribute to reliable accounting, timely financial closings and effective financial reporting.
You will work closely with the Finance Manager and the wider Finance team, gaining exposure to different areas of accounting and financial management. The role combines routine accounting tasks with analytical work, budgeting and audit-related activities.
We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, organised and comfortable taking responsibility for their work. You should enjoy working with numbers, identifying discrepancies and ensuring that financial information is accurate and delivered on time.
Job Responsibilities

Handle daily invoice processing and accounting transactions.

Contribute to monthly and annual financial closings, ensuring deadlines are met.

Perform bank reconciliations, manual journal entries and accruals.

Assist in preparing the 2027 budget and analysing the 2026 budget.

Prepare and provide financial documentation and supporting materials for audits.

Review financial information, identify discrepancies and support accurate financial reporting.

Maintain organised accounting records and ensure that financial documentation is complete and up to date.

Support the Finance Manager and colleagues with other finance-related tasks as required.

Your Background
We are looking for someone with:

A bachelor's degree or equivalent in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field.

Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial processes.

Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

A structured and analytical approach, with strong attention to detail.

The ability to work independently, take responsibility and manage tasks according to deadlines.

Good communication and collaboration skills, with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities.

It Would Be an Advantage If You Have

Previous work experience in accounting, budgeting or financial reporting.

Experience supporting internal or external audits.

Familiarity with SAP Finance modules, particularly SAP FI/CO.

Professional proficiency in Chinese, both written and spoken.

What You Can Expect
You will join a collaborative Finance team of five people, working in an international manufacturing environment where accuracy, accountability and teamwork are essential.
This role offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience across core finance activities, develop your understanding of statutory reporting and budgeting, and collaborate with colleagues across different functions.
We value responsibility, continuous learning, open communication and a practical approach to problem-solving. You will have the opportunity to broaden your financial knowledge while contributing to the day-to-day operations of our business.
We look forward to welcoming a new colleague who is eager to contribute, learn and grow with us. If you are ready to take the next step in your finance career and become part of our team, we would love to hear from you!
Employment type: Fixed-term employment for six months Working hours: Approximate four days per week, corresponding to a minimum of 30 hours per week Location: Senior Material Europe, Sweden Start date: As soon as possible

TECHLA is a Gothenburg-based consulting company working with modern product development across software, embedded systems, cloud and DevOps.
We started TECHLA with a simple idea: to build the kind of consulting company we would want to work for ourselves. We want to build long-term relationships, work with great people and create an environment where both our consultants and our clients can thrive.
We believe in transparency, trust and giving people the freedom and responsibility to grow. Our consultants should feel that they are part of something, have a real influence and are rewarded for the value they create.
At TECHLA, technology matters – but people matter even more. We believe the best results come from skilled people who take ownership, work closely together and genuinely care about what they deliver.
We are big enough to deliver, but small enough to care.
TECHLA is looking for C/C++ developers at different experience levels. You could work on embedded development in automotive, defence or telecom. Depending on the assignment, you might contribute to anything from in-vehicle systems and embedded platforms to radar and communication systems.
The role
As a consultant at TECHLA, you’ll work in one of our clients development teams or alongside TECHLA colleagues. Depending on the assignment, you may contribute throughout the development lifecycle - from requirements and technical design to implementation, integration, testing and further development.
Your work may include
Developing embedded software in C and C++
Working with Linux-based systems or real-time environments
Designing systems, implementing software and troubleshooting issues
Integrating and verifying software on target hardware
Improving development workflows, test automation and CI/CD
Collaborating with systems, hardware and test engineers

What we’re looking for
Experience developing software in C and/or C++
Experience with embedded development, preferably in Linux or a real-time environment
A university degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mechatronics, applied physics or a related field.
An interest in building high-quality, reliable software
Good communication and collaboration skills in English

We welcome developers with a few years of experience as well as senior engineers. In more senior roles, you may also take responsibility for technical design, support colleagues and help drive the team’s work forward.
It’s a plus if you have experience with
Depending on the assignment, any of the following may be valuable:
Embedded Linux, Yocto or an RTOS
Git, CI/CD and automated testing
AUTOSAR, CAN or Ethernet
Safety-critical systems and functional safety
Radar, telecom or automotive software

The mindset we’re looking for
For us, being a great engineer is about more than technical skills.
We’re looking for people with a strong consulting mindset – people who understand that great consulting is about creating real value, taking ownership and being someone both the team and the client can rely on.
You’re highly skilled at what you do, but you’re also a doer who cares about quality. You don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem. You take initiative, move things forward and care about delivering work you can genuinely be proud of.
At the same time, you genuinely enjoy working with others. You communicate openly, share knowledge, contribute to a positive team dynamic and believe that the best results are created together.
You take responsibility for the bigger picture, stay solution-oriented and aren’t afraid to go the extra mile when it makes a difference. At the same time, you’re humble, genuine and enjoy working with people who challenge and support each other.
In short, we’re looking for engineers who want to go beyond – technically, professionally and as part of a team.
We’re open to both employment and freelance/subcontractor setups – so whether you’re looking to join TECHLA or take on your next assignment as an independent consultant, we’d love to hear from you.
Feel free to reach out to johanna.bornemyr@techla.se or submit your application, and we’ll be happy to tell you more about the opportunities.

MAJORITY is a groundbreaking all-in-one digital financial service app that includes an FDIC-insured account, Visa® Prepaid card, money remittance, and international calling. We are built for migrants, by migrants.

Global migration is a 21st-century reality. Whether people are following their dreams, love or new experiences, more and more of us are leaning towards new environments. Our purpose at MAJORITY is to empower the amazing, the brave, and the talented and help them achieve all of their ambitions.

We believe that everyone deserves the same opportunity to succeed. Our mission is to provide migrants the tools to thrive in their new country. We are a diverse group of people from over 40 different countries that come together every day and we're looking for others driven by the same desire to create meaningful products that bridge cultural and geographic distances.

MAJORITY is looking for a skilled Senior Backend Developer to join our Backend team. This is a full time, hybrid position based at our office in Stockholm, Sweden. Developers may work from home up to 2 days a week.

The Opportunity
Hitachi Energy Cooling Systems is currently experiencing strong growth and is looking to strengthen our Plant Design team with a Project Engineer. Our mechanical design work is divided into three areas: system design, design of units that are assembled and tested in our factory, and design of external piping systems, where pipes are welded and delivered to site for installation.
This position is part of one of our mechanical design teams, responsible for designing external piping systems in a project-based environment.
The team is based in Landskrona, Sweden. We are a strong and collaborative team with a broad range of shared expertise, where teamwork is always a top priority.
We are excited to get to know you and learn what you can bring to the team, so we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every requirement. We value potential, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
How you’ll make an impact
Perform mechanical design work for external piping systems within project deliveries.
Create 3D models of piping systems and pipe supports based on process flow diagrams, specifications, and component lists.
Review and verify engineering drawings to ensure quality and compliance.
Manage material registration and bill of materials (BOM) creation in our ERP system.
Collaborate closely with customers, colleagues, and cross-functional teams such as Procurement and Production.
Work with engineering and business systems including Solid Edge and SAP. 

Your background
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering.
A few years of experience in piping design and mechanical design engineering or closely related engineering disciplines. Combined with a desire to continue learning and growing.
Experience working in project-based environments.
Proficiency in 3D modeling and design tools.
Experience from industries such as industrial cooling, water and wastewater treatment, biogas, marine, oil and gas, or nuclear power is an asset.
A proactive and self-driven approach, with the ability to manage priorities and meet project deadlines.
Curiosity, problem-solving skills, and a practical understanding of manufacturing and installation processes.
Fluent in both Swedish and English.

About Edblad
Edblad is a Swedish jewelry brand with a strong Scandinavian identity and a passion for creating accessible, contemporary jewelry designed to be worn every day. With a growing international presence, Edblad continues to develop its digital business and customer experience across multiple European markets.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence how Edblad tells its story digitally and contribute to the continued development of our e-commerce business.
About the role
As Senior e-commerce Content Creator, you will take ownership of how the Edblad story is brought to life across e-commerce, with the website as your primary channel.
This is a key role at the intersection of e-commerce and Marketing. You will take seasonal campaigns, concepts and creative direction from Marketing and Design and turn them into relevant and engaging digital content - from editorial stories and landing pages to gift guides, category content and other inspirational touchpoints.
Working across our international markets, you will consider the audience, market maturity and stage of the customer journey when shaping the message. Creativity and strong copywriting are at the heart of the role, combined with a commercial and data-driven approach to continuously improve how our content performs.
Key responsibilities:
Own the storytelling and consistency of e-commerce content, with the website as the primary channel
Translate seasonal campaigns and creative concepts into inspiring and commercially relevant digital content
Create and develop copy, editorial content, landing pages, gift guides and other inspirational content around the Edblad brand, collections and products
Adapt content and messaging to different markets, audiences, channels and stages of the customer journey
Use GA4 and content performance data to evaluate, optimize and develop content based on customer behaviour and commercial objectives
Develop content with SEO, search intent and evolving AI-driven search behaviours in mind
Collaborate closely with Marketing, Design, Performance, Social Media and E-commerce, including briefing additional content and assets when needed

Who we are looking for
We are looking for a senior content professional with excellent copywriting and storytelling skills and a strong understanding of e-commerce.
You have a strong creative instinct and know how to communicate a brand in a way that feels relevant and engaging. At the same time, you are comfortable using data to challenge assumptions, understand what resonates with customers, and make informed decisions about what to develop further.

What we do at Blykalla
Blykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit https://www.blykalla.com.

What you’ll get to do
You will own the design of the radioactive waste management systems for SEALER, covering the liquid, gaseous, and solid waste streams generated by the reactor over its life. This includes the systems that process, characterise, condition, package, and store waste, from the cover gas cleanup that handles activation products in the primary loop, to the treatment of contaminated liquids from maintenance operations, to the interfaces with spent fuel and decommissioning.
The lead-cooled fast reactor environment presents distinct waste challenges, solutions here need to combine solid nuclear waste engineering fundamentals with a proper understanding of the lead chemistry environment.
Define the functional and design requirements for SEALER's radioactive waste management systems, covering liquid, gaseous, and solid waste streams.
Develop and maintain the design basis for cover gas cleanup, liquid radwaste treatment, and solid waste characterisation, packaging, and storage.
Lead trade-off studies on waste minimisation at source versus downstream treatment, and quantify the impact on plant footprint, cost, and dose.
Interface with the Nuclear and Safety and licensing teams on waste categorisation, disposal routes, and regulatory expectations in Europe (i.e. SSM) and in the US (NRC).
Define the scope of supplier work packages on waste system equipment, evaluate proposals, and steer their execution through qualification.
Coordinate with the Material and Lead Chemistry teams on activation products and the handling of lead-contaminated components.
Support decommissioning-oriented design choices during the concept and preliminary design phases.
Contribute to the waste-related sections of the plant safety case and licensing documentation.

Who you’ll get to work with
The Nuclear Waste System Engineer sits in the Fluid Systems Engineering Team within Blykalla, and reports to the Manager of Fluid Systems Engineering. You will collaborate closely with the Nuclear and Safety, Material, Test and Validation, and Quality teams, as well as with external suppliers, research partners, and regulators. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla.

 
Who you are
You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help for you to succeed in this role, these are:
More than 5 years of professional experience in radioactive waste management, ideally in reactor design, waste treatment facility engineering, or spent fuel handling.
Degree in nuclear, chemical, environmental, or a closely related engineering discipline.
Working knowledge of the physical and chemical processes involved in liquid radwaste treatment (evaporation, ion exchange, filtration), gaseous waste cleanup (HEPA, adsorbers, delay beds), and solid waste conditioning (cementation, drum packaging).
Familiarity with nuclear waste categorisation (LLW, ILW, HLW) and disposal routes in at least one national regulatory framework.
Comfort writing clear technical specifications, reviewing supplier deliverables critically, and managing a multi-vendor technical dialogue from concept through qualification.
Familiarity with CAD tools and engineering software.
Fluent in English, spoken and written.
Fluency in Swedish is a plus.

Meritorious skills:
Experience with waste systems in Generation IV reactor programmes (LFR, SFR, MSR) or in research reactors with unusual coolants..
Experience interfacing with SSM (Sweden) or NRC (US) on waste-related submittals.
Prior work on commissioning or decommissioning of nuclear facilities.
Familiarity with activation calculations and source term evaluation.
Experience with nuclear waste transport, interim storage, or final disposal facilities.

Location 
This position is for our office in Stockholm.
